reden: Yes. The audit report’s “[Medium] TimelockTokenPool withdraw-by-signature is replayable” is the same issue: in TimelockTokenPool.sol’s withdraw(), the signature is over a static message plus _to without nonce/expiry/contract/chain binding, enabling replay. Both descriptions cite the same function and mechanism (ECDSA.recover on a hash lacking replay protection), same attack path (repeated calls to withdraw using the same sig to pull additional/unintended tokens), and share the same fix class (add nonce/domain separation or used-signature tracking). Severity difference doesn’t affect equivalence.
